title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Physics.hpp provides a four-variable 2-D compressible state, ideal-gas flux and constant-viscosity treatment; report.tex:60–123 describes governing equations.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CgnsReader.cpp:40–59,215–239 reads TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 in all zones of the first CGNS base; unknown/MIXED sections are skipped. MeshBuilder constructs geometry and adjacency.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Residual.cpp:31–72 assembles interior flux with opposite signs; :110–155 handles boundary and wall viscous contributions.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Physics.hpp:59 implements local Lax–Friedrichs/Rusanov flux; no higher-resolution Riemann solver credit is assumed.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Physics.hpp:115–182 implements farfield, slip and no-slip states; Residual.cpp:134–155 applies pressure-only inviscid and viscous no-slip wall fluxes.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Gradient.cpp:15–39 and Reconstruction.cpp:45–56 implement weighted LS face reconstruction. Final SteadySolver.cpp:92–105,139–145 delays M≥0.5 inviscid reconstruction beyond selected run lengths; historical binary is unbound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Reconstruction.cpp:6–41 implements Barth limiting and Residual.cpp:40–48 falls back on nonpositive face states. Final-source long first-order startup and unbound historic binary limit production-order evidence.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: OutputManager.cpp:118–135 uses full viscous traction in force integration; :203–217 projects tangential shear for cf. Report.tex:595–598 acknowledges negative viscous drag. Surface boundary velocities are zero on no-slip at :190–194,224.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: SteadySolver.cpp and ImplicitSolver.cpp implement pseudo-time continuation and LU-SGS; selected M2 laminar diverged before supplied target.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Final TransientSolver.cpp:182–214 measures the inner ratio after adding pseudo-time regularization; selected Re200 residual history has 943 steps at 2000 iterations, above configured/metadata maximum1000. Historical binary attribution and actual strict full-residual misses remain unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor halos exist, but main.cpp:89–109,136–156 retains full mesh on every rank through solver iterations. NACA np8 lift≈0.0303 differs materially from near-zero np1; the cylinder np8 result is a failed 200-step pilot.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
